ozet.olgu: twenty real worlds; nearest exoplanet; brightest star in our sky; young suns wrapped in dust; TRAPPIST-1 is a cool red star 40 light-years away with seven Earth-size planets; two-hour route (20 x 6:00).
ozet.not: Olgular dogru (40 ly, yedi Dunya boyutlu gezegen, soguk kirmizi cuce, 20x6 dk = 2 saat). Tek sorun soz: 13 durak yildiz ya da yildiz sistemi, dunya degil; 'twenty real worlds' gevsek. Oneri: 'twenty real worlds' yerine 'twenty real destinations'. Rakam/olgu degismez.

01.olgu: closest known exoplanet; 4.2 light-years (Proxima Centauri 4.25 ly); orbital period 11 days (11.2 d).
01.not: NASA Archive: period 11.2 gun, kesif 2016. Anglada-Escude 2016 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.03449): P~11.2 d, Proxima 1.295 pc = 4.22 ly (Gaia 4.25 ly), Gunes'in en yakin yildizi. 'Closest known exoplanet' dogru (2026 itibariyla).

02.olgu: two Sun-like stars; orbit each other every 80 years; nearest Sun-like stars; 4.4 light-years.
02.not: NASA/Hubble: A (G2) ve B (K1) ortak kutle merkezi etrafinda ~80 yilda doner (Beech/Akeson 2016: 79.91 yil). Sistem 4.37 ly (NASA genelde 4.3-4.4). B 'Gunes benzeri' sayilir (K1, biraz kucuk); 'nearest Sun-like stars' kabul edilebilir cunku Proxima M cuce.

03.olgu: found in 2024; closer to its star than Mercury is to the Sun; year lasts three days (3.15 d); 6 light-years (5.96 ly); small planet.
03.not: Gonzalez Hernandez ve ark., A&A 690, A79 (2024), doi 10.1051/0004-6361/202451311: P=3.15 gun, a~0.023 AU (Merkur 0.387 AU), min kutle ~0.3 Dunya. Basant ve ark. 2025 (ApJL) uc gezegen daha ekledi (toplam dort); b hala gecerli. Yuzey ~125 C, 'hot' dogru.

04.olgu: faint red dwarf, too dim to see without a telescope; often erupts in flares; 7.9 light-years.
04.not: Gaia: 2.4086 pc = 7.86 ly (7.9 dogru). Aktif M6V flare yildizi (Lin 2021: >1e31 erg flare gunde ~1; Guinan&Engle 2018 donme 2.7 gun). Gorunur kadir ~13.5 (SIMBAD'den bilinen deger; bu oturumda dogrudan teyit edilmedi), cplak gozle gorunmez kesin; ESA/NASA kaynaginda kadir sayisi ayrica dogrulanmadi.

05.olgu: brightest star in Earth's night sky; white dwarf companion circles it every 50 years; 8.6 light-years.
05.not: Bond ve ark. 2017 (HST): Sirius B yorunge periyodu 50.13 yil, sistem ~8.6 ly. Sirius gece gokyuzunun en parlak yildizi (Gunes haric).

06.olgu: young star under a billion years old (~850 Myr or less); wide belts of dust and ice; giant planet circles it every seven years (7.3-7.4 yr); 10.5 light-years.
06.not: Llop-Sayson ve ark. 2021 (AJ 162, 181): eps Eri b P=7.3-7.4 yil (2025 yeniden analiz 7.32 yil, ~1 Jupiter kutlesi). Yas: Di Folco 2004 ~850 Myr, Greaves 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...791L..11G) Herschel ile iki kusak (12-16 AU, 54-68 AU) cozdu; 'under a billion years' dogru. 10.5 ly dogru.

07.olgu: calm star a little smaller than the Sun; disk of dust about ten times richer than ours; 12 light-years (11.9 ly).
07.not: Lawler ve ark. 2014 (MNRAS) Herschel: toz diski kutlesi Kuiper kusaginin ~10 kati (Greaves 2004: en az 10 kat). Yildiz ~0.78 Gunes kutlesi, ~0.79 yaricap: 'a little smaller' dogru. Dikkat: 'ten times richer' Kuiper kusagina gore, tum Gunes Sistemi tozune degil; metin 'than ours' diyor, kabul edilebilir. Istege bagli sikilastirma: 'about ten times more dust than our Kuiper Belt'.

08.olgu: 'rocky' world; about three times Earth's mass; in its red star's habitable zone; slightly more starlight than Earth; 12 light-years.
08.not: Kutle 2.89 Dunya (Astudillo-Defru 2017, A&A 602, A88, https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.05386) bir ASGARI kutle (M sin i); NASA Archive 'super Earth' diyor, yaricap 1.51 sadece tahmin. Kayalik oldugu olculmedi (yaricap yok). Yildizdan alinan isik Dunya'nin ~%6 fazlasi (ikincil kaynak, A&A makalesi tablosundan teyit onerilir); HZ icinde, iç kenara yakin. 12 ly dogru (3.8 pc). Oneri: 'rocky' kelimesini cikar, 'at least' ekle.
08.duzeltme: A super-Earth of at least three Earth masses, in the habitable zone of its red star.

09.olgu: one of the most Earth-like planets known by mass, close to one Earth; year under five days (4.9 d); 12.5 light-years; discovered 2019.
09.not: NASA Archive: P=4.9 gun, kutle 1.05 (Zechmeister 2019) / 1.16 Dunya (Dreizler 2024). Asgari kutle (M sin i); 'close to one Earth' dogru. 12.5 ly: yildiz ~3.83 pc (NASA sayfasi mesafe vermiyor; Gaia degeri yaygin).

10.olgu: 'rocky' super-Earth about three times Earth's mass; near the warm inner edge of the habitable zone; 14 light-years (13.8 ly).
10.not: NASA Archive: kutle 3.41 Dunya (Wright 2016; sonraki analizlerde ~4.25), P=17.9 gun, a=0.089 AU. 'About three' dusuk yuvarlama; ASGARI kutle (M sin i), yaricap bilinmiyor, 'rocky' kanitli degil. HZ ic kenarina yakin: Kane ve ark. 2017 (ApJ 835, 9) 'ic kenara yakin' diyor; NASA sayfasi HZ ifadesi icermiyor. 14 ly dogru. Oneri: 'at least 3.4 Earth masses', 'rocky' cikar.
10.duzeltme: A super-Earth of at least 3.4 Earth masses, near the inner edge of its star's habitable zone.

11.olgu: circles the smallest star of a triple system; two more suns in its sky; 24 light-years.
11.not: ESO eso1328 (2013): Gliese 667C uclunun en dusuk kutleli uyesi (~0.3 Gunes), A ve B gezegenden gunduz gorunen parlak yildizlar, gece dolunay kadar isik verir. Mesafe: ESO 22 ly (Hipparcos), NASA Archive ~23.6 ly (7.24 pc, Gaia donemi); '24' Gaia/NASA'ya uyuyor, 22 ile 24 arasi kaynaga gore degisir. Rota sirasi (Wolf 1061c 13.8 < Cc 23.6 < Vega 25.0) her iki degerde bozulmaz. Gezegen sayisi tartismali ama Cc'nin varligi genelde kabul gorur.

12.olgu: bright young star; spins so fast it bulges at the equator; was the North Star about 14,000 years ago; 25 light-years.
12.not: Peterson ve ark. 2006 (Nature 440, 896) ve Aufdenberg ve ark. 2006 (ApJ 645, 664; https://orbi.uliege.be/bitstream/2268/19318/1/0603327v1.pdf): hizli donucu, ekvator ~%19-23 genis, ekvator hizi ~270 km/s, kutuptan bakilir (egim ~4.7 derece). Kutup yildizi ~MO 12.000 (=yaklasik 14.000 yil once) ve ~MS 13.700'de yine olacak. Gorsel notu (gorsel_istem 'flattened at its poles'): yildiz kutuptan bakildigi icin gercekte yuvarlak gorunur; konsept yazari gorseli gozden gecirebilir.

13.olgu: young star circled by a vast belt of icy dust; telescopes photographed the ring directly; 25 light-years.
13.not: Hubble ACS koronagraf 2004, Kalas ve ark. 2005: gorunur isikta dogrudan goruntu, 25 ly. Webb MIRI (2023) uc ic ice kusak gosterdi: https://science.nasa.gov/asset/webb/fomalhaut-dusty-debris-disk-miri-image/. Yildiz ~440 Myr 'genc' (sayi bu oturumda ayrica dogrulanmadi, metin sayi vermiyor).

14.olgu: innermost of seven Earth-size planets around a cool red star; year lasts a day and a half (1.51 d); Webb suggests bare rock without a thick atmosphere; 40 light-years.
14.not: NASA: b icin 'current data suggests it may be a bare rock with no atmosphere'; sistem ~40 ly. Gillon 2017 (Nature 542, 456): b-h yedi Dunya boyutlu gezegen, periyotlar 1.5-19 gun; Greene 2023 (Nature 618, 39) Webb MIRI: kalin atmosfer yok. Hedge ('suggest') yerinde.

15.olgu: second of the seven; year lasts 2.4 days (2.42 d); Webb found no thick, Venus-like atmosphere.
15.not: NASA: 'If c does have an atmosphere, it's very thin.' Zieba ve ark. 2023 (Nature 620, 746): gunduz sicakligi ~380 K, kalin CO2 atmosferi (Venus benzeri) disarida. Periyot 2.42 gun.

16.olgu: lies at the warm inner edge of the habitable zone; year lasts four days (4.05 d).
16.not: Yil suresi dogru (4.05 gun). Ancak NASA'nin Webb sayfasi b, c, d'yi 'too close' sayiyor: yasanabilir bolgenin DISINDA, ic tarafta; yalnizca e, f, g icinde. Gillon 2017 d'yi sinirda goruyordu ama NASA resmi anlatimi 'disinda'. 'Lies at the inner edge' kesin degil. Oneri: 'icinde' iddiasi yerine 'hemen disinda, kenara yakin'.
16.duzeltme: Just too close to its star for the habitable zone, but only barely. A year lasts four days.

17.olgu: among the most promising worlds for liquid water; year lasts about six days (6.10 d).
17.not: NASA: e yasanabilir bolgede, kalin hidrojen atmosferi Webb ile elendi, calisma suruyor. 'Among the most promising' modellere dayali (Wolf 2017, Turbet 2018) ve temkinli ifade; kesin 'sivi su var' degil, metin de oyle demiyor. Periyot 6.10 gun.

18.olgu: cool world on the outer side of the habitable zone; likely rich in water ice; year lasts nine days (9.21 d).
18.not: Periyot dogru (9.21 gun). NASA: f yasanabilir bolgenin ICINDE; 'dis tarafi' sayisal olarak tartisilir (isinma bu oturumda dogrulanmadi). 'Likely rich in water ice' kanitli degil: Agol 2021 (PSJ 2, 1) yogunluklar Dunya benzeri kayalik bilesimle (demir bakimindan yoksul) aciklanabilir, ya da hafif element/su katmaniyla; kesin degil. NASA: f icin Webb verisi hala analiz ediliyor. Oneri: 'possibly' ve 'habitable zone'.
18.duzeltme: A cool world in the habitable zone, possibly rich in water. A year there lasts nine days.

19.olgu: largest of the seven, slightly bigger than Earth (1.129 Earth radii); year lasts twelve days (12.4 d).
19.not: NASA Archive: P=12.4 gun, yaricap 1.129, kutle 1.321 Dunya; yedi gezegen icinde en buyuk yaricap ve kutle (Agol 2021: b 1.116, c 1.097, d 0.788, e 0.920, f 1.045, h 0.775 Dunya yaricapi).

20.olgu: outermost and coldest of the seven; all seven orbits would fit inside Mercury's orbit around the Sun.
20.not: h: P=18.77 gun, a=0.0619 AU, T_denge ~169 K (en soguk); Merkur a=0.387 AU (gunberi 0.307). NASA: 'All seven planets orbit closer to their star than Mercury does to the Sun.' JPL: https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/astronomers-confirm-orbital-details-of-trappist-1h/
